Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience working with large datasets and identifying actionable insights. Advanced SQL skills and experience performing complex data analysis. Understanding of payment ecosystems, fraud typologies, chargebacks, and transaction-risk indicators. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to present analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. Preferred Qualifications Experience within fintech, payments, banking, card issuing, or acquiring environments. description: Engineering Director – Data & AI WHO WE ARE At Maersk, we are on a transformative journey to become the Global Integrator of container logistics, connecting and simplifying our customers' supply chains through technology, data, and innovation. You will keep the current priorities on track while accelerating the shift from fragmented, tool-heavy, and centrally dependent models to scalable, governed, self-service capabilities that reduce overhead and improve business outcomes. You will own the strategy, architecture alignment, and execution of modern data foundations, self-service data query and reporting experiences, and AI-based engineering practices. The role requires deep collaboration across product, platform, SAP, enterprise architecture, security, data governance, and business teams—often beyond direct reporting lines—to influence outcomes at scale. Reduce operational overhead through automation, reusable data patterns, shared engineering standards, and simplified platform architecture. Drive the transition from project-by-project data delivery to scalable, product-oriented data foundations that support analytics, reporting, AI, and decision intelligence use cases. Establish clear engineering practices for data reliability, observability, performance, supportability, and operational resilience across critical data pipelines and products. Ensure reporting outputs are reliable, timely, consistent, secure, and aligned to business-critical decision-making needs. AI-Based Engineering & Data Product Outcomes Drive a strong focus on AI-based engineering, including AI-assisted development, intelligent data quality, automated insight generation, knowledge retrieval, and agentic workflows where they create measurable value. Build impactful data and AI products that solve priority business problems and are measured through adoption, operational improvement, cost reduction, better decisions, or productivity gains. Ensure data products are designed for reuse, discoverability, interoperability, and integration with AI platforms, copilots, agents, and decision intelligence solutions. Establish an outcome discipline where data, analytics, reporting, and AI investments are linked to clear value cases, usage measures, and business benefit realization. Promote responsible, secure, and governed AI adoption across engineering teams, ensuring AI solutions are reliable, explainable where needed, and aligned to enterprise controls. Keeping Existing Priorities on Track Maintain delivery discipline across current data engineering, analytics, reporting, and platform commitments while introducing modernization in a controlled, outcome-focused way. Guide build-vs-buy decisions with a pragmatic view of cost, speed, flexibility, engineering leverage, regulatory requirements, and long-term enterprise value. Cross-Organizational Influence Work collaboratively across Product, SAP, Platform, Infrastructure, Security, AI, Data Governance, and business teams beyond direct reporting lines. Influence enterprise decisions impacting data foundations, reporting modernization, AI adoption, platform investment, and cost optimization. Drive alignment across diverse stakeholders with competing priorities, ensuring the function remains focused on enterprise outcomes rather than local optimization. Engineering Excellence & Delivery Embed modern engineering practices, including DevOps, automation, CI/CD, testing, observability, reusable engineering patterns, and AI-assisted software delivery across data and AI platforms. Ensure delivery of scalable, secure, high-quality data platforms, reporting services, AI-enabled capabilities, and outcome-based data products. Establish performance, reliability, quality, adoption, value realization, and cost optimization metrics with strong governance controls. Build and scale high-performing teams with strong ownership, technical depth, delivery discipline, customer orientation, and continuous improvement mindset. Proven experience leading data engineering, analytics, reporting, AI, or data platform teams at scale. Strong understanding of enterprise data platforms, semantic layers, reporting ecosystems, AI platforms, cloud platforms, and distributed systems. Experience enabling self-service data access and self-service reporting while maintaining governance, quality, security, privacy, and compliance. Customer- and value-driven mindset with strong ownership, accountability, and focus on measurable business impact.
